title: Opposition coordination deepens in East Bengal
detail: Post-language-movement discontent over representation, governance, and economic imbalance encouraged opposition parties to coordinate around a common electoral platform.

title: United Front enters election campaign with mass appeal
detail: The coalition's programme connected everyday grievances with demands for provincial rights, attracting broad support across towns and rural constituencies.

title: United Front wins overwhelming provincial mandate
detail: In the East Bengal Legislative Assembly election, the United Front secured a landslide, while the Muslim League suffered a major defeat.

title: New provincial ministry faces immediate confrontation
detail: Despite electoral legitimacy, the new political arrangement entered conflict with central authorities over power, stability, and governance control.

title: Electoral verdict reshapes East Bengal's political trajectory
detail: The victory reinforced regional political consciousness and helped establish elections as a key arena for autonomy-oriented mass politics.
